oracle_limit: Inherited substring matcher does not enforce independent-group order, occurrence counts or per-process/property attribution. Separate processes do not establish same-process reset.

root_actions: Read-only Git/Python/source/native metadata plus local GO files; no push/CI/rerun/accounting.
